title: The Garden of Colors and Shapes
learningOutcomes: Respond to simple questions using appropriate vocabulary.
Identify the formation, sound, and words that begin with the letters Ss and Aa.
Use short phrases to describe nearby objects.
Recognize and name colors through familiar objects.
Trace letters Ss and Aa in their uppercase and lowercase forms.

lines.text: Me too! Oh, look! A butterfly!

vocabularyPolicyNote: 23 distinct source words were extracted from the reviewed pages. No supplementary vocabulary was added to reach 30; the requested 30-word threshold is not supported by the source pages reviewed.

grammar.note: The unit teaches short descriptive patterns, color statements, shape questions, and a simple present continuous sentence ('The butterfly is flying'). These are retained as printed language patterns, not expanded into a separate invented grammar lesson.

reading.note: The garden dialogue on page 26 and language patterns on pages 27 and 34–36 are the printed source texts. No separate reading passage with comprehension questions was found in the reviewed unit pages.

listening.note: The student book includes a printed dialogue and repeated listen-and-point tasks. Most listening exercises rely on teacher instructions and pictures; no separate audio recording or complete script for each exercise is printed.

assessment.note: The source activities are picture-dependent and many require listening to a teacher. They are indexed as activities, not converted into newly authored scored questions without a verified answer key.
